text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Normally, Umamusume who sought victory in the Classic Triple Crown go on to run medium- and long-distance races. But King Halo is different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To become first-rate in her own way, she chooses to run in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, a race that decides the best sprinter. She resolves to not have any regrets even if she doesn't place well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She isn't alone. I've come prepared to start anew as well, in pursuit of this goal.
